description: Secure credential storage for user authentication

id.description: Username, used directly as the primary key — the generic single-record adapter methods (read/update/remove) always operate on a column literally named "id", so this field holds the username value rather than a separate "username" column.

passwordHash.description: Argon2id self-describing encoded hash ($argon2id$v=19$m=...,t=...,p=...$salt$hash) — never returned in queries. Field name kept for schema back-compat with the pre-Argon2id rows this replaces.

salt.description: Unused by Argon2id (the salt is embedded in passwordHash's encoded format). Kept only for schema back-compat with rows written before this fix.

user.description: Credential belongs to a user account (Credential.id == User.username)
